features_verified: POST /api/orders creates order with auto-generated order_number (ORD-XXXX format)
GET /api/orders lists orders with search and status filters
GET /api/orders/{id} returns order with enriched job_tickets array
PUT /api/orders/{id} updates order and logs status changes to activity
DELETE /api/orders/{id} cascades to job tickets and production tasks
POST /api/job-tickets creates ticket linked to order, auto-generates production tasks if flow enabled
GET /api/job-tickets lists with filters (order_id, category, department, status)
GET /api/job-tickets/{id} returns ticket with production_tasks if flow enabled
PUT /api/job-tickets/{id} updates ticket, enables production flow toggle
GET /api/production-tasks list and filter by department, status, order, ticket
PUT /api/production-tasks/{id} updates status with timestamp history, triggers roll-up
POST /api/orders/{id}/generate-quote creates quote from job tickets
POST /api/orders/{id}/start-production activates workflow for enabled tickets
Status roll-up: completing all tasks on a ticket sets ticket to completed
Status roll-up: partial ticket completion sets order to partially_complete or in_production
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up test orders, job tickets, and production tasks during testing
